_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

features.title: sync-branch.sh brings a harness PR branch up to date with the default branch, resolving conflicts only in FEATURES.json (three-way by key and id) and PROGRESS.md / shared_paths (both sides kept), then runs the gate; any other conflict aborts
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-sync-branch.sh proving the checks below

checks.title: two parallel feature PRs both merge
steps: Two branches off the same base each append a FEATURES.json entry, flip it passing, add a PROGRESS.md entry at the top and a code file
Merge the first into main; run sync-branch.sh on the second
Main archives a feature and trims the oldest PROGRESS entry while a PR adds one; then a PR archives one while main adds one
checks.pass_if: exit 0 with zero edits; FEATURES.json valid with both ids in order and both passing; PROGRESS.md equals the expected file (every entry whole, branch entry first); archived entries and trimmed log entries stay gone on either side; the branch then merges into main with no conflict

checks.title: a real conflict stops it
steps: Both sides change the same code line
Both sides add the same new id with different content
Both sides change the same feature field differently
The same id added at different lines (git text merge clean)
A shared file that is binary, or deleted on one side
A hook refuses the merge commit
The branch archives a feature main changed
An untracked file the base branch starts tracking (exit 2 before merging, file intact)
checks.pass_if: exit 1 naming the file or JSON path; HEAD and the working tree are as before

checks.title: a red gate undoes the merge
steps: The merged result fails scripts/e2e.sh
checks.pass_if: exit 1, HEAD as before

features.notes: Reviewer (Codex) on the first version: 8 findings; fixed: ignored file overwritten, binary union exit ignored, clean text merge skipped the id rules, ids keyed by tostring, missing stage / refused commit left a merge in progress, text union split PROGRESS entries, tests blind to deletions. Not fixed: gate artifacts left after a red gate (any gate run leaves them).
